paragraphs: Abbey College Manchester is an independent sixth-form college located in the heart of Manchester city centre, at 5вЂ“7 Cheapside. Part of the Abbey DLD Group вЂ” which also operates colleges in London and Cambridge вЂ” the college has built a reputation for small classes, personalised tuition, and outstanding university placement results.

The college offers A-Levels, GCSEs, International Foundation Programmes across business, science, engineering, humanities, medicine, and creative arts pathways, as well as a Preparation Pathway for University. 31% of International Foundation Programme graduates progress to Russell Group universities, and the college regularly places students at Oxford, Cambridge, and leading UK medical schools.

International students from over 60 countries study at Abbey Manchester. With an average class size of just 6вЂ“8 students, each learner receives dedicated attention from subject specialists. The admissions team provides visa guidance, airport transfers, and a comprehensive induction programme.

Manchester itself is the UK's second-largest student city, home to five universities and a vibrant cultural scene. Students benefit from proximity to the Northern Quarter, Spinningfields, and excellent transport links to the rest of the UK and international airports.
